section_1.title: The Speedometer Paradox
section_1.content: Introduce the concept of 'speed at an exact moment' through a relatable scenario. Explain that while average speed is distance over time, a speedometer shows a value for a single point in time where the time elapsed is zero.
section_1.example: A cheetah chasing a gazelle. We can calculate its average speed over 10 seconds, but how fast is it moving exactly at the 4.5-second mark? The speedometer shows a specific number even though 'time' hasn't passed yet at that 'instant'.

section_2.title: Prerequisite: The Slope of a Line
section_2.content: Review the fundamental concept of slope (Rise over Run). Establish that for a straight line, the rate of change is constant and easy to calculate using two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
section_2.example: An animation of a climber walking up a steady mountain slope. The slope is calculated as (Change in Height) / (Horizontal Distance). This visual establishes the baseline for 'Rate of Change'.

section_3.title: The Secant Line Animation
section_3.content: Transition to a curved graph (distance vs. time). Introduce the 'Secant Line'—a line connecting two points on the curve. Explain that the slope of the secant represents the 'Average Rate of Change' between those two points.
section_3.example: On a graph of y = x², plot points A and B. Draw a blue line through them. Show that as point B moves closer to point A along the curve, the line changes its tilt.

section_4.title: The Concept of the Limit (h → 0)
section_4.content: Visually demonstrate the 'Shrinking Interval'. As the horizontal distance (h) between point A and point B approaches zero, the two points almost merge. This is the 'Limit'—the core of the derivative.
section_4.example: A magnifying glass effect zooming into the curve at point A. As we zoom in, the curve starts to look like a straight line. The interval 'h' is shown as a shrinking slider moving toward 0.

section_5.title: The Tangent Line and the Derivative
section_5.content: Define the Instantaneous Rate of Change as the slope of the Tangent Line (the line that touches the curve at exactly one point). Formally introduce the derivative notation and the limit definition formula.
section_5.example: The blue secant line from Section 3 turns bright orange and snaps into a 'Tangent' position. The formula f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h)-f(x)]/h appears, with visual labels connecting the formula parts to the graph's geometry.

section_6.title: Application: The Rocket Launch
section_6.content: Summarize how derivatives allow us to calculate precise changes in real-time. Emphasize that the derivative is simply a function that gives us the 'slope' or 'rate' at any given point.
section_6.example: A rocket launching into space. The curve represents its position. The derivative at any point 't' tells the mission control the rocket's exact instantaneous velocity, ensuring it reaches the correct orbit.

outline.title: The Speedometer Paradox
outline.content: Introduce the concept of 'speed at an exact moment' through a relatable scenario. Explain that while average speed is distance over time, a speedometer shows a value for a single point in time where the time elapsed is zero.
outline.example: A cheetah chasing a gazelle. We can calculate its average speed over 10 seconds, but how fast is it moving exactly at the 4.5-second mark? The speedometer shows a specific number even though 'time' hasn't passed yet at that 'instant'.

storyboard.title: The Speedometer Paradox
lecture_lines: Calculating average speed needs distance over time.
But how fast is a cheetah *exactly* now?
The speedometer shows speed at a single instant.
animations: Show a cheetah running across the screen.
Display a speedometer showing 100 km/h.
Freeze the action at 4.5 seconds.
Highlight the speedometer value '100' with a yellow glow (#FFFF00).
The text 'Distance/Time = 0/0?' appears in red (#FF0000) near the cheetah.

outline.title: The Concept of the Limit (h → 0)
outline.content: Visually demonstrate the 'Shrinking Interval'. As the horizontal distance (h) between point A and point B approaches zero, the two points almost merge. This is the 'Limit'—the core of the derivative.
outline.example: A magnifying glass effect zooming into the curve at point A. As we zoom in, the curve starts to look like a straight line. The interval 'h' is shown as a shrinking slider moving toward 0.

storyboard.title: The Concept of the Limit (h → 0)

Watch as we move the points closer together.
As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears.
We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero.
The curve starts to look like a straight line.
animations: Zoom in on the region around point A to show the curve's detail.
Show a horizontal segment 'h' between A and B in yellow (#FFFF00).
Animate 'h' shrinking until it reaches zero, making the curve look linear.

It touches the curve at exactly one point.
This slope is the instantaneous rate of change.
We call this new value the derivative.
The formal limit definition defines this magic moment.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Grid starts at x=0.5, extends to 5.5
                # y starts at 2.2, extends down to -2.8
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title = "Application: The Rocket Launch"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Derivatives calculate precise changes in real-time.",
            "This rocket's speed changes at every single moment.",
            "The derivative gives the exact velocity needed."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        PATH_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        TANGENT_COLOR = "#FFA500"
        ROCKET_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Define the parabolic path: y = 0.12(x-0.5)^2 - 1.8
        # Domain x in [0.5, 5.5]
        path = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([
                t, 
                0.12 * (t - 0.5)**2 - 1.8, 
                0
            ]),
            t_range=[0.5, 5.5],
            color=PATH_COLOR
        )
        
        # Represent rocket as a simple triangle
        rocket = Triangle(color=ROCKET_COLOR, fill_opacity=1).scale(0.2)
        rocket.rotate(-PI/2) # Orient to point along the x-axis initially
        
        # Setup position tracker
        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0) # proportion from 0 to 1
        
        def get_pos():
            return path.point_from_proportion(t_tracker.get_value())
            
        def get_angle():
            # Derivative at proportion p (x = 0.5 + 5p)
            # dy/dx = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            return np.arctan2(slope, 1)

        # Move rocket to start
        rocket.move_to(path.get_start())
        rocket.set_angle(get_angle())

        self.play(Create(path), run_time=2)
        self.play(FadeIn(rocket))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight second line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Tangent line representing velocity
        tangent_line = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=TANGENT_COLOR, stroke_width=4).scale(1.2)
        
        # Add updaters for smooth motion
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(tangent_line))
        # Move along part of the path
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(0.4), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight third line
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Slope value indicator
        slope_label = MathTex(r"v = ", color=TANGENT_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_label, "A5", scale_factor=0.8) # Positioning in top right grid area
        
        slope_value = DecimalNumber(0, color=TANGENT_COLOR, num_decimal_places=2)
        slope_value.next_to(slope_label, RIGHT)
        
        # Update function for the decimal number
        def update_slope_val(m):
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            m.set_value(slope)
            
        slope_value.add_updater(update_slope_val)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(slope_value))
        
        # Finish ascent
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=3, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(3)
        
        # Clean up
        rocket.clear_updaters()
        tangent_line.clear_updaters()
        slope_value.clear_updaters()

            "The secant line finally becomes a tangent line.",
            "It touches the curve at exactly one point.",
            "This slope is the instantaneous rate of change.",
            "We call this new value the derivative.",
            "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        ORANGE = "#FFA500"
        BLUE = "#0000FF"
        YELLOW = "#FFFF00"
        WHITE_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"

        # Helper for lines

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===

            y_range=[-0.5, 4.5, 1],

        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        curve = axes.plot(func, x_range=[-0.2, 3], color=WHITE_COLOR)
        
        # Points for Secant
        x_a = 1.0
        x_b = 2.5
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, func(x_a)), color=RED)
        dot_b = Dot(axes.c2p(x_b, func(x_b)), color=BLUE)

        def get_line(x1, x2, color, length=4):
            y1, y2 = func(x1), func(x2)
            slope = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) if abs(x2 - x1) > 0.0001 else x1
            mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
            mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2
            
            angle = np.arctan(slope)
            p1 = axes.c2p(mid_x - length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y - length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            p2 = axes.c2p(mid_x + length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y + length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            return Line(p1, p2, color=color)

        secant_line = get_line(x_a, x_b, BLUE, length=3.5)

        self.play(Indication(dot_a, color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Formula: f'(x) = lim_{h -> 0} (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h
        formula = MathTex(
            "f'(x)", "=", "\\lim_{h \\to 0}", "\\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}",
            font_size=32, color=WHITE_COLOR
        )
        self.place_in_area(formula, 'A2', 'B5', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We call this new value the derivative."
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Flash "h -> 0" (which is index 2 in formula parts)
        self.play(formula[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Flash(formula[2], color=YELLOW, flash_radius=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Arrow from tangent slope to f'(x)
        arrow = Arrow(
            start=tangent_label.get_top(),
            end=formula[0].get_bottom(),
            color=WHITE_COLOR,
            buff=0.1
        )
        self.play(Create(arrow))
        self.play(Indication(formula[0], color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(2)

            "Watch as we move the points closer together.",
            "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears.",

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2

        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

            l.set_points_as_corners([

            ])

section_1.title: The Speedometer Paradox
section_1.content: Introduce the concept of 'speed at an exact moment' through a relatable scenario. Explain that while average speed is distance over time, a speedometer shows a value for a single point in time where the time elapsed is zero.
section_1.example: A cheetah chasing a gazelle. We can calculate its average speed over 10 seconds, but how fast is it moving exactly at the 4.5-second mark? The speedometer shows a specific number even though 'time' hasn't passed yet at that 'instant'.

section_2.title: Prerequisite: The Slope of a Line
section_2.content: Review the fundamental concept of slope (Rise over Run). Establish that for a straight line, the rate of change is constant and easy to calculate using two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
section_2.example: An animation of a climber walking up a steady mountain slope. The slope is calculated as (Change in Height) / (Horizontal Distance). This visual establishes the baseline for 'Rate of Change'.

section_3.title: The Secant Line Animation
section_3.content: Transition to a curved graph (distance vs. time). Introduce the 'Secant Line'—a line connecting two points on the curve. Explain that the slope of the secant represents the 'Average Rate of Change' between those two points.
section_3.example: On a graph of y = x², plot points A and B. Draw a blue line through them. Show that as point B moves closer to point A along the curve, the line changes its tilt.

section_4.title: The Concept of the Limit (h → 0)
section_4.content: Visually demonstrate the 'Shrinking Interval'. As the horizontal distance (h) between point A and point B approaches zero, the two points almost merge. This is the 'Limit'—the core of the derivative.
section_4.example: A magnifying glass effect zooming into the curve at point A. As we zoom in, the curve starts to look like a straight line. The interval 'h' is shown as a shrinking slider moving toward 0.

section_5.title: The Tangent Line and the Derivative
section_5.content: Define the Instantaneous Rate of Change as the slope of the Tangent Line (the line that touches the curve at exactly one point). Formally introduce the derivative notation and the limit definition formula.
section_5.example: The blue secant line from Section 3 turns bright orange and snaps into a 'Tangent' position. The formula f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h)-f(x)]/h appears, with visual labels connecting the formula parts to the graph's geometry.

section_6.title: Application: The Rocket Launch
section_6.content: Summarize how derivatives allow us to calculate precise changes in real-time. Emphasize that the derivative is simply a function that gives us the 'slope' or 'rate' at any given point.
section_6.example: A rocket launching into space. The curve represents its position. The derivative at any point 't' tells the mission control the rocket's exact instantaneous velocity, ensuring it reaches the correct orbit.

        ticks = VGroup(*[

            for i in range(5)
        ])
        
        # Needle pivot is the arc center
        needle = Line(ORIGIN, LEFT * 1.0, color=RED, stroke_width=5)
        
        speed_num = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=0, font_size=36, color=WHITE)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        title_text = "The Concept of the Limit (h \u2192 0)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Let the distance between points be 'h'.",
            "Watch as we move the points closer together.",
            "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears.",
            "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero.",
            "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_H = "#FFFF00"
        COLOR_CURVE = "#87CEEB"
        COLOR_POINT = "#FF6347"

        # Coordinate system setup
        ax = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 3, 1],
            y_range=[0, 3, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False},
            x_length=5,
            y_length=5
        )
        self.place_in_area(ax, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)

        def func(x):
            return 0.2 * x**2 + 0.5

        curve = ax.plot(func, x_range=[0, 3], color=COLOR_CURVE)
        
        # Point A is fixed at a specific spot on the curve
        ax_pos_a = [1.2, func(1.2)]
        dot_a = Dot(ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a), color=COLOR_POINT)
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24).next_to(dot_a, DL, buff=0.1)

        # Value tracker for h (distance between points)
        h_tracker = ValueTracker(1.2)

        # Persistent mobjects for dynamic elements
        dot_b = Dot(color=COLOR_POINT)
        h_line = Line(color=COLOR_H, stroke_width=4)
        h_label = MathTex("h", color=COLOR_H, font_size=24)
        secant = Line(color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        # Updaters for dynamic elements
        def update_dot_b(d):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            d.move_to(ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h)))

        def update_h_line(l):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            l.set_points_as_corners([
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0], ax_pos_a[1]),
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, ax_pos_a[1])
            ])

        def update_h_label(m):
            m.next_to(h_line, DOWN, buff=0.1)

        def update_secant(l):
            p1 = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            p2 = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h))
            vec = p2 - p1
            if np.linalg.norm(vec) > 0.001:
                u = vec / np.linalg.norm(vec)
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 1.5, p1 + u * 3.5])
            else:
                # Tangent fallback
                p2_alt = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01, func(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01))
                u = (p2_alt - p1) / np.linalg.norm(p2_alt - p1)
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 1.5, p1 + u * 3.5])

        dot_b.add_updater(update_dot_b)
        h_line.add_updater(update_h_line)
        h_label.add_updater(update_h_label)
        secant.add_updater(update_secant)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "Let the distance between points be 'h'."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(ax), Create(curve))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_a), Write(label_a))
        
        # Zoom in on A as per storyboard
        zoom_center = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
        all_visuals = VGroup(ax, curve, dot_a, label_a, dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        
        self.add(dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2.5, about_point=zoom_center),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "Watch as we move the points closer together."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(secant))
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.6), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears."
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.02), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_H)
        all_visuals.add(secant)
        # Final zoom to emphasize the linearity
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2, about_point=zoom_center),
            secant.animate.set_stroke(width=4),
            run_time=3
        )
        self.wait(2)

        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Section 5 Data
        title = "The Tangent Line and the Derivative"
        lecture_lines = [
            "The secant line finally becomes a tangent line.",
            "It touches the curve at exactly one point.",
            "This slope is the instantaneous rate of change.",
            "We call this new value the derivative.",
            "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        ORANGE = "#FFA500"
        BLUE = "#0000FF"
        YELLOW = "#FFFF00"
        WHITE_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"

        # Helper for lines
        func = lambda x: 0.5 * x**2
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Create Graph
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3.5, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 4.5, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True}
        ).scale(0.8)
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        curve = axes.plot(func, x_range=[-0.2, 3], color=WHITE_COLOR)
        
        # Points for Secant
        x_a = 1.0
        x_b = 2.5
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, func(x_a)), color=RED)
        dot_b = Dot(axes.c2p(x_b, func(x_b)), color=BLUE)
        
        # Label for Point A
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24).next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        def get_line(x1, x2, color, length=4):
            y1, y2 = func(x1), func(x2)
            slope = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) if abs(x2 - x1) > 0.0001 else x1
            mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
            mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2
            
            angle = np.arctan(slope)
            p1 = axes.c2p(mid_x - length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y - length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            p2 = axes.c2p(mid_x + length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y + length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            return Line(p1, p2, color=color)

        secant_line = get_line(x_a, x_b, BLUE, length=3.5)

        self.add(axes, curve, dot_a, dot_b, label_a, secant_line)
        self.wait(1)

        # Transition to Tangent
        tangent_line = get_line(x_a, x_a, ORANGE, length=4.0)
        
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        self.play(
            Transform(secant_line, tangent_line),
            dot_b.animate.move_to(dot_a.get_center()).set_opacity(0),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        
        tangent_label = Text("Tangent: Instantaneous Rate", font_size=16, color=ORANGE)
        self.place_at_grid(tangent_label, 'C5', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(tangent_label))
        self.play(Indicate(dot_a, color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Formula: f'(x) = lim_{h -> 0} (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h
        formula = MathTex(
            "f'(x)", "=", "\\lim_{h \\to 0}", "\\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}",
            font_size=32, color=WHITE_COLOR
        )
        self.place_in_area(formula, 'A2', 'B5', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We call this new value the derivative."
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Flash "h -> 0" (which is index 2 in formula parts)
        self.play(formula[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Flash(formula[2], color=YELLOW, flash_radius=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Arrow from tangent slope to f'(x)
        arrow = Arrow(
            start=tangent_label.get_top(),
            end=formula[0].get_bottom(),
            color=WHITE_COLOR,
            buff=0.1
        )
        self.play(Create(arrow))
        self.play(Indicate(formula[0], color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title = "Application: The Rocket Launch"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Derivatives calculate precise changes in real-time.",
            "This rocket's speed changes at every single moment.",
            "The derivative gives the exact velocity needed."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        PATH_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        TANGENT_COLOR = "#FFA500"
        ROCKET_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Define the parabolic path: y = 0.12(x-0.5)^2 - 1.8
        # Domain x in [0.5, 5.5]
        path = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([
                t, 
                0.12 * (t - 0.5)**2 - 1.8, 
                0
            ]),
            t_range=[0.5, 5.5],
            color=PATH_COLOR
        )
        
        # Represent rocket as a simple triangle
        rocket = Triangle(color=ROCKET_COLOR, fill_opacity=1).scale(0.2)
        rocket.rotate(-PI/2) # Orient to point along the x-axis initially
        
        # Setup position tracker
        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0) # proportion from 0 to 1
        
        def get_pos():
            return path.point_from_proportion(t_tracker.get_value())
            
        def get_angle():
            # Derivative at proportion p (x = 0.5 + 5p)
            # dy/dx = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            return np.arctan2(slope, 1)

        # Move rocket to start
        rocket.move_to(path.get_start())
        rocket.set_angle(get_angle())

        self.play(Create(path), run_time=2)
        self.play(FadeIn(rocket))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight second line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Tangent line representing velocity
        tangent_line = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=TANGENT_COLOR, stroke_width=4).scale(1.2)
        
        # Add updaters for smooth motion
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(tangent_line))
        # Move along part of the path
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(0.4), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight third line
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Slope value indicator
        slope_label = MathTex(r"v = ", color=TANGENT_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_label, "A5", scale_factor=0.8) # Positioning in top right grid area
        
        slope_value = DecimalNumber(0, color=TANGENT_COLOR, num_decimal_places=2)
        slope_value.next_to(slope_label, RIGHT)
        
        # Update function for the decimal number
        def update_slope_val(m):
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            m.set_value(slope)
            
        slope_value.add_updater(update_slope_val)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(slope_value))
        
        # Finish ascent
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=3, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(3)
        
        # Clean up
        rocket.clear_updaters()
        tangent_line.clear_updaters()
        slope_value.clear_updaters()

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title_text = "The Secant Line Animation"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Most real-world movement follows a curved path.",
            "A secant line connects two points on the curve.",
            "Its slope shows the average speed between them."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors as specified
        curve_color = "#FFFFFF"   # White
        point_color = "#ADD8E6"   # Light Blue
        secant_color = "#0000FF"  # Blue

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight matching the curve color
        self.lecture[0].set_color(curve_color)

        # Setup Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 3, 1],
            y_range=[0, 9, 2],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": WHITE},
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "A1", "F6")
        
        # Create curve y = x^2
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, x_range=[0, 2.5], color=curve_color)
        curve_label = MathTex("y = x^2", font_size=24, color=curve_color)
        self.place_at_grid(curve_label, "A6")

        self.play(Create(axes), Create(curve), Write(curve_label), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Update colors: dim previous, highlight current with point/line color
        self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(point_color)

        # Points A and B with ValueTracker for B
        x_a = 0.5
        x_b_start = 2.0
        x_b_tracker = ValueTracker(x_b_start)
        
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2), color=point_color)
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24, color=point_color)
        label_a.next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        dot_b = Dot(color=point_color)
        dot_b.move_to(axes.c2p(x_b_start, x_b_start**2))
        dot_b.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(axes.c2p(x_b_tracker.get_value(), x_b_tracker.get_value()**2)))
        
        label_b = MathTex("B", font_size=24, color=point_color)
        label_b.add_updater(lambda l: l.next_to(dot_b, RIGHT, buff=0.1))
        
        # Secant Line connecting A and B
        secant_line = Line(axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2), axes.c2p(x_b_start, x_b_start**2), color=secant_color, stroke_width=4)
        
        def update_secant(line):
            start = axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2)
            end = axes.c2p(x_b_tracker.get_value(), x_b_tracker.get_value()**2)
            line.set_points_by_ends(start, end)
        
        secant_line.add_updater(update_secant)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot_a), Write(label_a),
            FadeIn(dot_b), Write(label_b),
            Create(secant_line),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Update colors: dim previous, highlight current with secant color
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(secant_color)

        # Label for the slope
        slope_label = Text("Slope = Average Speed", font_size=20, color=secant_color)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_label, "F2")
        
        self.play(Write(slope_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # Animate point B sliding along the curve toward point A
        self.play(
            x_b_tracker.animate.set_value(0.7),
            run_time=4,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # Final cleanup: keep colors or reset
        self.play(self.lecture.animate.set_color(WHITE), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)

outline.title: The Speedometer Paradox
outline.content: Introduce the concept of 'speed at an exact moment' through a relatable scenario. Explain that while average speed is distance over time, a speedometer shows a value for a single point in time where the time elapsed is zero.
outline.example: A cheetah chasing a gazelle. We can calculate its average speed over 10 seconds, but how fast is it moving exactly at the 4.5-second mark? The speedometer shows a specific number even though 'time' hasn't passed yet at that 'instant'.

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial Setup
        title = "The Speedometer Paradox"
        lines = [
            "Calculating average speed needs distance over time.",
            "But how fast is a cheetah exactly now?",
            "The speedometer shows speed at a single instant."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Use YELLOW for current line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Speedometer setup
        speed_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        # Speedometer Mobjects (Right side area D4 to F6)
        arc = Arc(radius=1.2, start_angle=PI, angle=-PI, color=BLUE_B)
        ticks = VGroup(*[
            Line(arc.point_from_proportion(i/4), arc.point_from_proportion(i/4)*0.8, color=WHITE)
            for i in range(5)
        ])
        
        # Needle pivot is the arc center
        needle = Line(ORIGIN, LEFT * 1.0, color=RED, stroke_width=5)
        
        speed_num = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=0, font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        unit_label = Text("km/h", font_size=18, color=GREY_B)
        
        speedometer = VGroup(arc, ticks, needle, speed_num, unit_label)
        self.place_in_area(speedometer, "D4", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Post-placement positions for sub-elements
        cp = arc.get_arc_center()
        speed_num.move_to(cp + DOWN * 0.4)
        unit_label.next_to(speed_num, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        # Efficient Updaters
        speed_num.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(speed_tracker.get_value()))
        
        def update_needle(m):
            val = speed_tracker.get_value()
            angle = PI - (val / 100) * PI
            length = 1.0 * 0.8 # Account for group scaling
            new_end = cp + np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0]) * length
            m.set_points_as_corners([cp, new_end])
        
        needle.add_updater(update_needle)
        
        # Cheetah representation (Grid B1 to B6)
        cheetah_body = Square(side_length=0.4, fill_color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8, color=YELLOW)
        cheetah_label = Text("Cheetah", font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(cheetah_body, UP, buff=0.1)
        cheetah = VGroup(cheetah_body, cheetah_label)
        self.place_at_grid(cheetah, "B1")
        
        # Ground Path
        path = Line(self.grid["B1"], self.grid["B6"], color=GREY_E, stroke_width=2)
        dist_label = Text("Distance", font_size=18, color=GREY_C).next_to(path, UP, buff=0.8)
        
        self.add(path, speedometer)
        self.play(FadeIn(cheetah, dist_label))
        
        # Movement 1: Demonstrate "Distance over Time"
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(self.grid["B6"]),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(100),
            run_time=4,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Update lecture colors
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Reset for the "instantaneous" demonstration
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(self.grid["B1"]),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(0),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # Move and freeze at "4.5s" mark (visualized as 75% through the path)
        freeze_pos = self.grid["B1"] + 0.75 * (self.grid["B6"] - self.grid["B1"])
        
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(freeze_pos),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(100),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        
        # Freeze action highlight
        self.play(Indicate(cheetah, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Update lecture colors
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Highlight speedometer value '100' with yellow glow (#FFFF00)
        glow_rect = SurroundingRectangle(speed_num, color="#FFFF00", buff=0.1, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(
            speed_num.animate.set_color("#FFFF00"),
            Create(glow_rect)
        )
        
        # Paradox text near cheetah (Red #FF0000)
        paradox_text = Text("Distance/Time = 0/0?", color="#FF0000", font_size=28)
        self.place_at_grid(paradox_text, "C4", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(paradox_text))
        self.play(Flash(paradox_text, color="#FF0000"))
        
        self.wait(3)

outline.content: Define the Instantaneous Rate of Change as the slope of the Tangent Line (the line that touches the curve at exactly one point). Formally introduce the derivative notation and the limit definition formula.
outline.example: The blue secant line from Section 3 turns bright orange and snaps into a 'Tangent' position. The formula f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h)-f(x)]/h appears, with visual labels connecting the formula parts to the graph's geometry.

storyboard.title: The Tangent Line and the Derivative
lecture_lines: The secant line finally becomes a tangent line.
It touches the curve at exactly one point.
This slope is the instantaneous rate of change.
We call this new value the derivative.
The formal limit definition defines this magic moment.
animations: The blue secant line turns into a bright orange (#FFA500) tangent line at point A.
Label the line as 'Tangent: Instantaneous Rate' in orange (#FFA500).
Display the derivative formula f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h)-f(x)]/h in white (#FFFFFF).
Flash the 'h to 0' part of the formula in yellow (#FFFF00) to emphasize the limit.
An arrow points from the tangent slope to the f'(x) result in the formula.

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Section 5 Data
        title = "The Tangent Line and the Derivative"
        lecture_lines = [
            "The secant line finally becomes a tangent line.",
            "It touches the curve at exactly one point.",
            "This slope is the instantaneous rate of change.",
            "We call this new value the derivative.",
            "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        ORANGE = "#FFA500"
        BLUE = "#0000FF"
        YELLOW = "#FFFF00"
        WHITE_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"

        # Helper for lines
        func = lambda x: 0.5 * x**2
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Create Graph
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3.5, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 4.5, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True}
        ).scale(0.8)
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        curve = axes.plot(func, x_range=[-0.2, 3], color=WHITE_COLOR)
        
        # Points for Secant
        x_a = 1.0
        x_b = 2.5
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, func(x_a)), color=RED)
        dot_b = Dot(axes.c2p(x_b, func(x_b)), color=BLUE)
        
        # Label for Point A
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24).next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        def get_line(x1, x2, color, length=4):
            y1, y2 = func(x1), func(x2)
            slope = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) if abs(x2 - x1) > 0.0001 else x1
            mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
            mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2
            
            angle = np.arctan(slope)
            p1 = axes.c2p(mid_x - length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y - length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            p2 = axes.c2p(mid_x + length/2 * np.cos(angle), mid_y + length/2 * np.sin(angle))
            return Line(p1, p2, color=color)

        secant_line = get_line(x_a, x_b, BLUE, length=3.5)

        self.add(axes, curve, dot_a, dot_b, label_a, secant_line)
        self.wait(1)

        # Transition to Tangent
        tangent_line = get_line(x_a, x_a, ORANGE, length=4.0)
        
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        self.play(
            Transform(secant_line, tangent_line),
            dot_b.animate.move_to(dot_a.get_center()).set_opacity(0),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        
        tangent_label = Text("Tangent: Instantaneous Rate", font_size=16, color=ORANGE)
        self.place_at_grid(tangent_label, 'C5', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(tangent_label))
        self.play(Indicate(dot_a, color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Formula: f'(x) = lim_{h -> 0} (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h
        formula = MathTex(
            "f'(x)", "=", "\\lim_{h \\to 0}", "\\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}",
            font_size=32, color=WHITE_COLOR
        )
        self.place_in_area(formula, 'A2', 'B5', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We call this new value the derivative."
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Flash "h -> 0" (which is index 2 in formula parts)
        self.play(formula[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Flash(formula[2], color=YELLOW, flash_radius=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The formal limit definition defines this magic moment."
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(WHITE_COLOR))
        
        # Arrow from tangent slope to f'(x)
        arrow = Arrow(
            start=tangent_label.get_top(),
            end=formula[0].get_bottom(),
            color=WHITE_COLOR,
            buff=0.1
        )
        self.play(Create(arrow))
        self.play(Indicate(formula[0], color=ORANGE))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        title_text = "The Concept of the Limit (h \u2192 0)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Let the distance between points be 'h'.",
            "Watch as we move the points closer together.",
            "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears.",
            "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero.",
            "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_H = "#FFFF00"
        COLOR_CURVE = "#87CEEB"
        COLOR_POINT = "#FF6347"

        # Coordinate system setup
        ax = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 3, 1],
            y_range=[0, 3, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False},
            x_length=5,
            y_length=5
        )
        self.place_in_area(ax, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)

        def func(x):
            return 0.2 * x**2 + 0.5

        curve = ax.plot(func, x_range=[0, 3], color=COLOR_CURVE)
        
        # Point A is fixed at a specific spot on the curve
        ax_pos_a = [1.2, func(1.2)]
        dot_a = Dot(ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a), color=COLOR_POINT)
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24).next_to(dot_a, DL, buff=0.1)

        # Value tracker for h (distance between points)
        h_tracker = ValueTracker(1.2)

        # Persistent mobjects for dynamic elements
        dot_b = Dot(color=COLOR_POINT)
        h_line = Line(color=COLOR_H, stroke_width=4)
        h_label = MathTex("h", color=COLOR_H, font_size=24)
        secant = Line(color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        # Updaters for dynamic elements
        def update_dot_b(d):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            d.move_to(ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h)))

        def update_h_line(l):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            l.set_points_as_corners([
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0], ax_pos_a[1]),
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, ax_pos_a[1])
            ])

        def update_h_label(m):
            m.next_to(h_line, DOWN, buff=0.1)

        def update_secant(l):
            p1 = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            p2 = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h))
            vec = p2 - p1
            if np.linalg.norm(vec) > 0.001:
                u = vec / np.linalg.norm(vec)
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 1.5, p1 + u * 3.5])
            else:
                # Tangent fallback
                p2_alt = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01, func(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01))
                u = (p2_alt - p1) / np.linalg.norm(p2_alt - p1)
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 1.5, p1 + u * 3.5])

        dot_b.add_updater(update_dot_b)
        h_line.add_updater(update_h_line)
        h_label.add_updater(update_h_label)
        secant.add_updater(update_secant)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "Let the distance between points be 'h'."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(ax), Create(curve))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_a), Write(label_a))
        
        # Zoom in on A as per storyboard
        zoom_center = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
        all_visuals = VGroup(ax, curve, dot_a, label_a, dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        
        self.add(dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2.5, about_point=zoom_center),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "Watch as we move the points closer together."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(secant))
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.6), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears."
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.02), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_H)
        all_visuals.add(secant)
        # Final zoom to emphasize the linearity
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2, about_point=zoom_center),
            secant.animate.set_stroke(width=4),
            run_time=3
        )
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title = "Application: The Rocket Launch"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Derivatives calculate precise changes in real-time.",
            "This rocket's speed changes at every single moment.",
            "The derivative gives the exact velocity needed."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        PATH_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        TANGENT_COLOR = "#FFA500"
        ROCKET_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Define the parabolic path: y = 0.12(x-0.5)^2 - 1.8
        # Domain x in [0.5, 5.5]
        path = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([
                t, 
                0.12 * (t - 0.5)**2 - 1.8, 
                0
            ]),
            t_range=[0.5, 5.5],
            color=PATH_COLOR
        )
        
        # Represent rocket as a simple triangle
        rocket = Triangle(color=ROCKET_COLOR, fill_opacity=1).scale(0.2)
        rocket.rotate(-PI/2) # Orient to point along the x-axis initially
        
        # Setup position tracker
        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0) # proportion from 0 to 1
        
        def get_pos():
            return path.point_from_proportion(t_tracker.get_value())
            
        def get_angle():
            # Derivative at proportion p (x = 0.5 + 5p)
            # dy/dx = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            return np.arctan2(slope, 1)

        # Move rocket to start
        rocket.move_to(path.get_start())
        rocket.set_angle(get_angle())

        self.play(Create(path), run_time=2)
        self.play(FadeIn(rocket))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight second line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Tangent line representing velocity
        tangent_line = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=TANGENT_COLOR, stroke_width=4).scale(1.2)
        
        # Add updaters for smooth motion
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        rocket.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(get_pos()))
        tangent_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(get_angle()))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(tangent_line))
        # Move along part of the path
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(0.4), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight third line
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # Slope value indicator
        slope_label = MathTex(r"v = ", color=TANGENT_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_label, "A5", scale_factor=0.8) # Positioning in top right grid area
        
        slope_value = DecimalNumber(0, color=TANGENT_COLOR, num_decimal_places=2)
        slope_value.next_to(slope_label, RIGHT)
        
        # Update function for the decimal number
        def update_slope_val(m):
            p = t_tracker.get_value()
            x = 0.5 + 5 * p
            slope = 0.24 * (x - 0.5)
            m.set_value(slope)
            
        slope_value.add_updater(update_slope_val)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(slope_value))
        
        # Finish ascent
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=3, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(3)
        
        # Clean up
        rocket.clear_updaters()
        tangent_line.clear_updaters()
        slope_value.clear_updaters()

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title_text = "The Secant Line Animation"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Most real-world movement follows a curved path.",
            "A secant line connects two points on the curve.",
            "Its slope shows the average speed between them."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors as specified
        curve_color = "#FFFFFF"   # White
        point_color = "#ADD8E6"   # Light Blue
        secant_color = "#0000FF"  # Blue

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight matching the curve color
        self.lecture[0].set_color(curve_color)

        # Setup Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 3, 1],
            y_range=[0, 9, 2],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": WHITE},
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "A1", "F6")
        
        # Create curve y = x^2
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, x_range=[0, 2.5], color=curve_color)
        curve_label = MathTex("y = x^2", font_size=24, color=curve_color)
        # Resolved Issue 25: move curve_label to B5
        self.place_at_grid(curve_label, "B5", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Create(axes), Create(curve), Write(curve_label), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Update colors: dim previous, highlight current with point/line color
        self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(point_color)

        # Resolved Issue 20: Use vehicle asset for point B
        vehicle = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vehicle.svg")
        vehicle.set_color(point_color)
        vehicle.scale(0.2)

        # Points A and B with ValueTracker for B
        x_a = 0.5
        x_b_start = 2.0
        x_b_tracker = ValueTracker(x_b_start)
        
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2), color=point_color)
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24, color=point_color)
        label_a.next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        # Vehicle represents point B
        vehicle.move_to(axes.c2p(x_b_start, x_b_start**2))
        vehicle.add_updater(lambda v: v.move_to(axes.c2p(x_b_tracker.get_value(), x_b_tracker.get_value()**2)))
        
        label_b = MathTex("B", font_size=24, color=point_color)
        label_b.add_updater(lambda l: l.next_to(vehicle, RIGHT, buff=0.1))
        
        # Secant Line connecting A and B
        secant_line = Line(axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2), axes.c2p(x_b_start, x_b_start**2), color=secant_color, stroke_width=4)
        
        def update_secant(line):
            start = axes.c2p(x_a, x_a**2)
            end = axes.c2p(x_b_tracker.get_value(), x_b_tracker.get_value()**2)
            line.set_points_by_ends(start, end)
        
        secant_line.add_updater(update_secant)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot_a), Write(label_a),
            FadeIn(vehicle), Write(label_b),
            Create(secant_line),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Update colors: dim previous, highlight current with secant color
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(secant_color)

        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors

        BLUE = "#0000FF"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===

        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3.5, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 4.5, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.7)
        
        curve = axes.plot(func, x_range=[-0.2, 3], color=WHITE_COLOR)
        
        # Points for Secant
        x_a = 1.0
        x_b = 2.5
        dot_a = Dot(axes.c2p(x_a, func(x_a)), color=RED_COLOR)
        dot_b = Dot(axes.c2p(x_b, func(x_b)), color=BLUE)
        
        # Label for Point A
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24).next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        def get_line(x1, x2, color, length=4):
            y1, y2 = func(x1), func(x2)
            p1_coord = np.array([x1, y1, 0])
            p2_coord = np.array([x2, y2, 0])
            
            if abs(x2 - x1) > 0.0001:
                direction = p2_coord - p1_coord
            else:
                # Tangent direction: [1, f'(x1), 0]. f'(x) = x for 0.5x^2
                direction = np.array([1, x1, 0]) 
            
            direction = direction / np.linalg.norm(direction)
            mid_coord = (p1_coord + p2_coord) / 2
            
            start_coord = mid_coord - direction * (length / 2)
            end_coord = mid_coord + direction * (length / 2)
            
            return Line(axes.c2p(*start_coord), axes.c2p(*end_coord), color=color)

        secant_line = get_line(x_a, x_b, BLUE, length=3.5)

        )

        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        title_text = "The Concept of the Limit (h \u2192 0)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Let the distance between points be 'h'.",
            "Watch as we move the points closer together.",
            "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears.",
            "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero.",
            "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_H = "#FFFF00"
        COLOR_CURVE = "#87CEEB"
        COLOR_POINT = "#FF6347"

        # Coordinate system setup
        ax = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 3, 1],
            y_range=[0, 3, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False},
            x_length=5,
            y_length=5
        )
        # Fix: Adjust scale and position of axes per Critic feedback to avoid overlap
        self.place_in_area(ax, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=0.6)

        def func(x):
            return 0.2 * x**2 + 0.5

        curve = ax.plot(func, x_range=[0, 3], color=COLOR_CURVE)
        
        # Point A is fixed at a specific spot on the curve
        ax_pos_a = [1.2, func(1.2)]
        dot_a = Dot(ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a), color=COLOR_POINT)
        
        # Fix: Place label_a at specific grid point with smaller scale per Critic
        label_a = MathTex("A", font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(label_a, 'D3', scale_factor=0.4)

        # Value tracker for h (distance between points)
        h_tracker = ValueTracker(1.2)

        # Persistent mobjects for dynamic elements
        dot_b = Dot(color=COLOR_POINT)
        h_line = Line(color=COLOR_H, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Fix: Place h_label at specific grid point with smaller scale per Critic
        h_label = MathTex("h", color=COLOR_H, font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(h_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.4)
        
        secant = Line(color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        # Updaters for dynamic elements
        def update_dot_b(d):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            d.move_to(ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h)))

        def update_h_line(l):
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            l.set_points_as_corners([
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0], ax_pos_a[1]),
                ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, ax_pos_a[1])
            ])

        def update_h_label(m):
            # Updater keeps the label near the interval line as it shrinks
            m.next_to(h_line, DOWN, buff=0.1)

        def update_secant(l):
            p1 = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
            h = h_tracker.get_value()
            p2 = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + h, func(ax_pos_a[0] + h))
            vec = p2 - p1
            if np.linalg.norm(vec) > 0.001:
                u = vec / np.linalg.norm(vec)
                # Fix: Shortened line length (from 1.5/3.5 to 0.5/2.0) to avoid obstructing lecture notes on the left
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 0.5, p1 + u * 2.0])
            else:
                # Tangent fallback
                p2_alt = ax.c2p(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01, func(ax_pos_a[0] + 0.01))
                u = (p2_alt - p1) / np.linalg.norm(p2_alt - p1)
                l.set_points_as_corners([p1 - u * 0.5, p1 + u * 2.0])

        dot_b.add_updater(update_dot_b)
        h_line.add_updater(update_h_line)
        h_label.add_updater(update_h_label)
        secant.add_updater(update_secant)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "Let the distance between points be 'h'."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(ax), Create(curve))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_a), Write(label_a))
        
        # Zoom in on A as per storyboard
        zoom_center = ax.c2p(*ax_pos_a)
        all_visuals = VGroup(ax, curve, dot_a, label_a, dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        
        self.add(dot_b, h_line, h_label)
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2.5, about_point=zoom_center),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "Watch as we move the points closer together."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(Create(secant))
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.6), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "As 'h' shrinks, the interval nearly disappears."
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "We are finding the limit as 'h' approaches zero."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_H)
        self.play(h_tracker.animate.set_value(0.02), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "The curve starts to look like a straight line."
        self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_H)
        all_visuals.add(secant)
        # Final zoom to emphasize the linearity
        self.play(
            all_visuals.animate.scale(2, about_point=zoom_center),
            secant.animate.set_stroke(width=4),
            run_time=3
        )
        self.wait(2)
